conclusion: Unfenced logical bank parity was insufficient; dynamic lifetime fence introduces 144-byte local frame, static stages cause C7512. Drained form restores 8-byte ABI frame/no spills/no C751x in both FINE modes and every wide PTX MMA is followed by wait0 without a branch bypass. H200 is still required.
